test.create_query: CREATE TABLE map_src (m Map(LowCardinality(String), LowCardinality(String))) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE map_none (id UInt64, m Map(LowCardinality(String), LowCardinality(String))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE map_keys (id UInt64, m Map(LowCardinality(String), LowCardinality(String)), INDEX ik mapKeys(m) TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE map_values (id UInt64, m Map(LowCardinality(String), LowCardinality(String)), INDEX iv mapValues(m) TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id

CREATE TABLE otel_src ( Timestamp DateTime64(9), TimestampTime DateTime DEFAULT toDateTime(Timestamp), TraceId String, SpanId String, TraceFlags UInt8, SeverityText LowCardinality(String), SeverityNumber UInt8, ServiceName LowCardinality(String), Body String, ResourceSchemaUrl LowCardinality(String), ResourceAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String), ScopeSchemaUrl LowCardinality(String), ScopeName String, ScopeVersion LowCardinality(String), ScopeAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String), LogAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE otel_none AS otel_src ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toDate(TimestampTime) PRIMARY KEY (ServiceName, TimestampTime) ORDER BY (ServiceName, TimestampTime, Timestamp)

CREATE TABLE otel_logs ( Timestamp DateTime64(9) CODEC(Delta(8), ZSTD(1)), TimestampTime DateTime DEFAULT toDateTime(Timestamp), TraceId String CODEC(ZSTD(1)), SpanId String CODEC(ZSTD(1)), TraceFlags UInt8, SeverityText LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD(1)), SeverityNumber UInt8, ServiceName LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD(1)), Body String CODEC(ZSTD(1)), ResourceSchemaUrl LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD(1)), ResourceAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD(1)), ScopeSchemaUrl LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD(1)), ScopeName String CODEC(ZSTD(1)), ScopeVersion LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD(1)), ScopeAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD(1)), LogAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD(1)), INDEX idx_trace_id TraceId TYPE bloom_filter(0.001) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_res_attr_key mapKeys(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_res_attr_value mapValues(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_scope_attr_key mapKeys(ScopeAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_scope_attr_value mapValues(ScopeAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_log_attr_key mapKeys(LogAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_log_attr_value mapValues(LogAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_body Body TYPE tokenbf_v1(32768, 3, 0) GRANULARITY 8 ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toDate(TimestampTime) PRIMARY KEY (ServiceName, TimestampTime) ORDER BY (ServiceName, TimestampTime, Timestamp)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO map_src SELECT mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> concat(['http', 'k8s', 'db', 'net', 'user', 'app'][1 + cityHash64(number, i) % 6], '.attr_', toString(cityHash64(number, i) % 300)), range(8 + number % 5)), arrayMap(i -> toString(cityHash64(number, i, 7) % 1000), range(8 + number % 5))) FROM numbers(2000000)

INSERT INTO otel_src (Timestamp, TraceId, SpanId, TraceFlags, SeverityText, SeverityNumber, ServiceName, Body, ResourceSchemaUrl, ResourceAttributes, ScopeSchemaUrl, ScopeName, ScopeVersion, ScopeAttributes, LogAttributes) SELECT toDateTime64('2026-09-01 00:00:00', 9) + number / 100, hex(cityHash64(number, 1)) || hex(cityHash64(number, 2)), hex(cityHash64(number, 3)), 1, ['INFO', 'INFO', 'INFO', 'WARN', 'ERROR', 'DEBUG'][1 + cityHash64(number, 4) % 6], 9, concat('service-', toString(cityHash64(number) % 50)) AS service, concat('GET /api/v', toString(number % 3), '/', toString(cityHash64(number, 5) % 1250), ' status=', toString(200 + cityHash64(number, 6) % 5 * 100)), 'https://opentelemetry.io/schemas/1.21.0', map('service.name', service, 'host.name', concat('host-', toString(cityHash64(number, 7) % 200)), 'k8s.pod.name', concat(service, '-', toString(cityHash64(number, 8) % 20)), 'k8s.namespace.name', concat('ns-', toString(cityHash64(number, 9) % 8)), 'cloud.region', ['eu-west-1', 'us-east-1', 'ap-south-1'][1 + cityHash64(number, 10) % 3], 'telemetry.sdk.language', 'go'), '', 'otelcol', '0.110.0', map(), mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> concat(['http', 'k8s', 'db', 'net', 'user', 'app'][1 + cityHash64(number, i) % 6], '.attr_', toString(cityHash64(number, i) % 300)), range(8 + number % 5)), arrayMap(i -> toString(cityHash64(number, i, 7) % 100000), range(8 + number % 5))) FROM numbers(250000)
test.query: INSERT INTO map_none SELECT rowNumberInAllBlocks(), m FROM map_src
INSERT INTO map_keys SELECT rowNumberInAllBlocks(), m FROM map_src
INSERT INTO map_values SELECT rowNumberInAllBlocks(), m FROM map_src
INSERT INTO otel_none SELECT * FROM otel_src
INSERT INTO otel_logs SELECT * FROM otel_src
